text: In both widgets, on a host that does not advertise `downloadFile` and where a clipboard copy succeeds, the export copies the content and shows "This host can't save files — CSV copied to clipboard" in the table widget and "This host can't save files — Export copied to clipboard" in memory admin, with any warning tail appended.

In both widgets, when `app.downloadFile` resolves with a result that does not have `isError: true` (an empty result included), the widget shows "Downloaded query_results.csv ✓" in the table widget and "Downloaded memory-export.json ✓" or "Downloaded memory-export.csv ✓" in memory admin, with any warning tail appended, and copies nothing.

In both widgets, when `app.downloadFile` resolves with `isError: true`, the widget shows "Download cancelled or blocked by the host." with any warning tail appended (in memory admin, in the red error banner, never the green success banner), never shows a "Downloaded" message, does not write to the clipboard, and does not show the overlay.

In both widgets, when `app.downloadFile` throws and a clipboard copy succeeds, the widget shows "Download failed (timed out) — CSV copied to clipboard" (memory admin: "Download failed (timed out) — Export copied to clipboard") for a thrown error whose `code` is -32001 (the SDK request timeout), and "Download failed (<the error's message>) — …" with the same ending for any other thrown error, in both cases with any warning tail appended.

In both widgets, when the content reaches the overlay, the overlay hint opens with the same reason the clipboard message would have given ("This host can't save files" or "Download failed (<reason>)"), followed by "and the clipboard is blocked. Select all and copy:", and no longer says "Host blocked the file download".
Both widgets call `app.downloadFile` with resource URI `file:///query_results.csv` (table widget) or `file:///memory-export.<json|csv>` (memory admin) and with request option `timeout: 600000`.
Each widget's Export button label is unchanged whatever the host's capabilities.

A node-run test covers each row of the Desired Behavior table, for the table widget (`exportCsv`) and for memory admin (`offerDownload`), at minimum: no capability with clipboard success; download resolving to an empty result; download resolving to `{isError: true}`; download throwing a timeout error; download throwing another error; no capability with both clipboard methods failing (overlay). `pytest -q` passes, and the existing check that warnings survive every export route in `tests/unit/test_output_boundaries.py` still passes.

The change leaves host-side `downloadFile` support unchanged: on a host that does not advertise the capability, such as the tenant website chat widget if it does not, export still produces no file. A host-cancel and a host-refusal stay indistinguishable, because the SDK reports both as `isError: true`. A save dialog left open for more than 10 minutes still times out into the "Download failed (timed out)" clipboard route.
